name: [voice-demo] Calls are producing failed turns
message:
At least one turn in the last five minutes failed outright: a provider call errored, or the agent produced nothing to say.

A failed turn is worse than a slow one. The caller hears silence, and silence is the one failure mode a phone line must never have — so this monitor has no warning threshold and no tolerance. One is too many.

The call log's `turns[].error` field names the stage that failed, and the APM trace for the same `call_id` shows where in the pipeline it stopped. A turn that failed with an injected fault is expected during the demo's provider-degraded beat, where the STT error rate is set to 10%.

@slack-voice-demo
